display.purpose: Home page hero only — the single most dramatic heading per visit. Compress leading to 0.95 at full size.

headline.purpose: One per inner page (Menu, Events, Gallery, etc). Fluid from 2.75rem to 6rem.

title.purpose: Home page section headings and inner-page sub-sections. Fluid from 1.5rem to 2.5rem.

body.purpose: Sustained reading copy. Always Inter 400 at 1rem/1.65 line-height. Never Playfair at this scale.

label.purpose: Amber amber eyebrow preceding every Playfair heading. 0.75rem, Inter 700, tracking 0.2em, uppercase.

shadows.name: warm
shadows.purpose: Base ambient glow under featured elements at rest. Subtle separation without drama.

shadows.name: warm-lg
shadows.purpose: Hover state on prominent cards and feature tiles.

shadows.name: warm-xl
shadows.purpose: Maximum amber glow — reserved for the most prominent interactive states.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Dark structural shadow under cards at rest. Pairs with warm glow on hover.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Deep shadow on card hover, combined with translateY(-5px) for physical lift.

shadows.name: button-glow
shadows.purpose: Amber halo under btn-primary on hover. Reinforces the lift with emitted light.

shadows.name: glow-pulse-peak
shadows.purpose: Peak frame of the glowPulse keyframe animation. Used on featured decorative elements only.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all translateY/translateX movement — card lifts, button lifts, drawer open. Sharp deceleration = physical feel.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Symmetric enter/exit for elements that both appear and disappear (modals, full overlays).

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Mobile drawer and bottom sheet entry — the snap-in feel of a physical panel sliding into place.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: focus ring, color feedback. Anything that should feel instantaneous.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Standard interaction response: button hover lift, nav transitions, mobile menu open/close.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Spatial movement: card lift, image hover zoom, header scroll transition.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Minor grid adjustments — 1-col to 2-col on feature grids.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Primary breakpoint — desktop nav, multi-column layouts, section padding expansions. The only breakpoint that matters for layout decisions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The highest-intent action. Amber gradient, near-black text, 2px radius. Lifts on hover (pointer: fine only).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.9rem 2rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-amber, #D4943A) 0%, var(--color-amber-light, #F0A830) 100%); color: var(--color-black, #100E0B); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border: none; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.3); transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-amber-light, #F0A830) 0%, #FFB840 100%); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(212,148,58,0.4), 0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.97); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber, #D4943A); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Second-tier action. Transparent with cream border, slightly smaller lift than primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.9rem 2rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-cream, #F5EFE0); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border: 1.5px solid rgba(245,239,224,0.35); border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: rgba(245,239,224,0.75); background: rgba(245,239,224,0.08); } } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber, #D4943A); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary action. Amber border fills solid amber on hover — a full inversion. Used on dark section backgrounds.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-amber, #D4943A); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-amber, #D4943A); border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-amber, #D4943A); color: var(--color-black, #100E0B); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(212,148,58,0.3); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber, #D4943A); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-card, #2C2418); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #3D3220); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease; box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); border-color: rgba(212,148,58,0.25); } } .ds-card-image { width: 100%; height: 200px; background: var(--color-surface, #221C16); } .ds-card-body { padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem 1.5rem; } .ds-card-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-amber, #D4943A); margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-text, #F5EFE0); letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.15; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-text-muted, #9A8A6A); }

components.css: .ds-nav-header { background: rgba(16,14,11,0.97); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border, #3D3220); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-nav { max-width: 80rem; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 1.5rem; height: 5rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-nav-wordmark { display: flex; flex-direction: column; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-wordmark-main { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--color-cream, #F5EFE0); transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-wordmark:hover .ds-nav-wordmark-main { color: var(--color-amber, #D4943A); } .ds-nav-wordmark-sub { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-text-muted, #9A8A6A); margin-top: -2px; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.125rem; list-style: none; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: block; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: rgba(245,239,224,0.7); border-radius: 2px; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #F5EFE0; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: var(--color-amber, #D4943A); } .ds-nav-link--active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 1rem; right: 1rem; height: 2px; background: var(--color-amber, #D4943A); border-radius: 9999px; }

narrative.overview:
The Merc's visual system is built from the materials of a place that has earned its warmth — richly darkened wood, amber firelight, the weight of good food and cold beer. The palette is not warm-for-warm's-sake; it is earned depth. Brown-blacks that hover between espresso and woodsmoke anchor the backgrounds. Amber gold — always in gradient, never flat — carries the brand's energy the way a lit window carries welcome. Cream stands in for white: softer, richer, more honest.

The typography is deliberately theatrical without being theatrical about it. Playfair Display lands with editorial weight — tight leading, negative tracking, tight-to-the-edge on hero headings — and then steps back entirely to let Inter carry the actual work: labels, captions, buttons, navigation. The pairing is confident: Playfair makes the impression, Inter closes the deal.

Motion in this system is felt, not watched. Interactions respond to the user's hand — a 2px lift on hover, a 3% scale compression on press — without performing for an audience. The goal is tactile credibility, not animation theatre. Every moving thing in this system has a reason to move.
keyCharacteristics: Amber gold earns its place — primary accent on ≤15% of any screen at a time
Playfair Display for drama; Inter for everything that needs to be read
Almost-square corners (2px on interactive elements, 4px on containers) — sharp and considered, not cold
Depth through tonal layering and warm shadows, not flat decoration
Motion is micro-physical: lifts, compressions, fades — not slides, spins, or bounces

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber is used in one active role at a time: CTA, active state, or accent decoration. Stacking amber text, amber border, and amber glow on the same element dilutes the effect to noise.

rules.name: The Warm Floor Rule
rules.body: No pure #000000 or #FFFFFF ever appears in this system. The floor is #100E0B; the ceiling is #F5EFE0. Neutrals carry warmth at every level.

rules.name: The Display/Body Firewall
rules.body: Playfair Display is used exclusively for headings (h1–h5 and the display-* utility classes). Inter handles all UI, labels, buttons, and body copy. A Playfair Display paragraph is a system violation, not a stylistic choice.

rules.name: The Size Floor Rule
rules.body: No text smaller than 0.75rem (12px) is used for any information — only the badge-* status pill at 0.7rem is the documented exception, where weight and contrast compensate.

rules.name: The Single Breakpoint Rule
rules.body: Design decisions are made for mobile first, then lg — not for sm, md, xl in sequence. If a layout looks right at 375px and 1280px, it works for everyone in between.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: All elements start flat. Shadows appear only in response to state (hover, elevation, focus), never as static decoration on body copy or plain containers.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: No rgba(0,0,0,X) shadows appear without a corresponding amber warm shadow alongside them. The sole exception is card and card-hover (structural dark shadows) which are paired with border-color changes for warmth.

rules.name: The No-Round Rule
rules.body: rounded-md (6px), rounded-lg (8px), and above are not used in this system. Anything softer than 4px breaks the sharp, considered character of the brand.

dos: Do use rgba(212, 148, 58, X) for all amber-tinted glow shadows — the exact color is the brand signature. Do not substitute with rgba(255, 165, 0, X) or any other orange.
Do gate all hover transform effects (translateY lifts, scale lifts on images) behind @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) — touch users get no transform flash.
Do apply the section-label class (amber, Inter, uppercase, wide tracking) as the eyebrow above every Playfair Display section heading.
Do use var(--ease-out) (cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)) for any translateY or translateX movement — the sharp deceleration is the physical feel of the brand.
Do keep muted (#9A8A6A) as the minimum text color for informational text on dark backgrounds — it meets WCAG AA contrast (~5.9:1 on merc-black).
Do use transition-property explicitly on all interactive elements — never transition: all, which composites off-GPU and introduces janky scroll-based repaints.
donts: Don't use rounded-md (6px) or larger on buttons, nav elements, or cards. The house radius is 2px (interactive) and 4px (containers). Rounder shapes break the sharp, considered character.
Don't add amber text, amber border, and amber glow to the same element simultaneously — amber's power comes from scarcity. One amber role per element.
Don't use animate-pulse or looping CSS animations on status indicators or decorative dots in the main UI flow. Looping motion is distracting and violates prefers-reduced-motion intent.
Don't use Playfair Display for body copy, captions, or any text that needs to be sustained reading. Its high contrast and display proportions are designed for display sizes only.
Don't use transition: all — specify only the properties that actually change (transform, opacity, background, border-color, box-shadow).
Don't use #7A6A50 (text-subtle) for any information that needs to be read — it is below WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds. Restrict it to decorative italic footnotes.
Don't introduce pure #000000 or #FFFFFF — the warm floor is #100E0B, the warm ceiling is #F5EFE0.
